## Why Speed, Cost, and Accuracy Are the Only Three Metrics That Matter


There are dozens of employee background check tools in India, each claiming to be the “best.” But when you strip away the marketing, only three things determine whether a tool actually works for your hiring process: **how fast it returns results** , **how much it costs per check** , and **how accurate (fraud-proof) those results are** .


Here’s why:


**Speed determines whether you lose candidates.** According to[LinkedIn’s hiring data](https://www.linkedin.com/) , top candidates in India are off the market within 10 days. If your background check takes 7–15 business days, the candidate has already accepted another offer by the time you get results.


**Cost determines whether you actually run checks.**[AuthBridge’s Workforce Fraud Files H1 FY26](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) found **4.33% of white-collar hires** have discrepancies. But if verification costs Rs. 1,500–Rs. 5,000 per candidate, most Indian SMBs skip it entirely — turning a Rs. 200 check into a Rs. 2,00,000 bad-hire problem.


**Accuracy determines whether the check actually catches fraud.** A tool that calls previous employers and takes their word for it is fundamentally less accurate than one that queries government databases (EPFO, Income Tax, MoRTH) where records cannot be fabricated.


### How We Scored Each Tool


We ranked all 10 tools on three axes:


Metric What We Measured How We Scored (1–10)


**Speed** Time from initiating a check to receiving results 10 = under 2 min, 8 = same day, 6 = 1–2 days, 4 = 3–5 days, 2 = 7+ days


**Cost** Published or estimated per-candidate price for a standard check (identity + employment) 10 = under Rs. 200, 8 = Rs. 200–Rs. 500, 6 = Rs. 500–Rs. 1,000, 4 = Rs. 1,000–Rs. 2,000, 2 = Rs. 2,000+ or unpublished


**Accuracy** Data source reliability — government database API vs. employer outreach vs. candidate-provided documents 10 = real-time government API, 8 = government database (delayed), 6 = digital cross-reference, 4 = manual outreach, 2 = document-only


**Maximum possible score: 30/30.** No tool scores a perfect 30 because no single platform excels equally at all three. But the ranking reveals clear winners and clear trade-offs.


Let’s see how the 10 most popular background check tools in India stack up.

### What the Scores Tell Us


> **SalaryBox Verify is the only tool that scores 10/10 on all three metrics.** It achieves this by doing one thing differently from every other platform: querying government databases (Income Tax, EPFO, MoRTH, Election Commission) directly via API, which delivers instant results (speed), from tamper-proof government records (accuracy). No other tool on this list matches all three.


**The trade-off pattern is clear:**


- **OnGrid and SurePass** match SalaryBox on speed and accuracy (government APIs) but lose on cost (unpublished, requires sales/dev)
- **AuthBridge and IDfy** score well on accuracy (government databases + AI/field) but lose on speed (days, not minutes) and cost (enterprise pricing)
- **SpringVerify and HelloVerify** score decently on cost (published pricing) but lose on speed (days) and accuracy (manual outreach, not government APIs)
- **Pietos and Verifacts** offer unique physical verification but score low on speed and accuracy for digital checks

**Cost** 10/10 Rs. 26 (PAN), Rs. 126 (DL/Voter ID), Rs. 170 (EPFO). Published, no hidden fees.

**Why It Ranks #1:** SalaryBox Verify is the only tool on this list that scores a perfect 30/30 because it delivers on all three metrics simultaneously. It queries the Income Tax Department (PAN), EPFO (UAN past employment history), MoRTH VAHAN/SARATHI (Driving Licence), and the Election Commission (Voter ID) directly through government APIs — meaning results arrive in under 2 minutes, cost as little as Rs. 26 per check, and come from tamper-proof government records.

### Accuracy Advantage


SalaryBox Verify’s accuracy comes from querying **government databases directly** rather than relying on:


- Candidate-provided documents (which can be forged)
- Employer outreach (which can be gamed with fake references)
- Manual verification (which depends on the verifier’s diligence)


The UAN/EPFO check alone catches the 4 most common hiring frauds in India: fake employment history, inflated tenure, salary inflation, and moonlighting — all from one government record that candidates cannot alter.

## #2 AuthBridge — Most Comprehensive Enterprise Coverage (14/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 4/10 Standard BGV: 2–7 working days. Some API checks: 24–48 hours.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom enterprise pricing. Requires sales call and annual contract.


**Accuracy** 8/10 Government databases (Aadhaar, PAN, eCourts, EPFO) + field agents across 600+ court districts.


**Why It Ranks #2:** AuthBridge is India’s largest background verification company, processing millions of checks annually. They publish the[Workforce Fraud Files](https://authbridge.com/newsroom/workforce-fraud-files-h1-fy26-hiring-discrepancies-india/) — the most cited hiring discrepancy report in India. Their accuracy score is high (8/10) because they combine government database access with physical field verification and 600+ court district coverage. But speed (2–7 days) and cost (enterprise pricing) drag their total score down significantly.


**Best for:** Large enterprises (500+ hires/year) that need comprehensive coverage including criminal records, field verification, and global checks, and can afford multi-day turnaround times.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** AuthBridge covers more check types (criminal, education, field verification), but for the core identity + employment checks that catch 80% of fraud, SalaryBox Verify delivers the same government data in 2 minutes at Rs. 196 instead of 2–7 days at enterprise pricing.


## #3 IDfy — Best AI-Powered Accuracy (17/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 7/10 Real-time for identity/document checks. Employment and criminal: 1–5 days.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom enterprise pricing. Requires sales engagement.


**Accuracy** 8/10 AI-powered OCR + liveness detection + government databases (Aadhaar, PAN, EPFO, DigiLocker, eFIR).


**Why It Ranks #3:** IDfy processes over 100 million verifications annually, and according to[IndiaAI](https://indiaai.gov.in/article/idfy-deploys-ai-to-detect-fraud-and-clear-the-fog-of-deceptiveness) , their AI catches document tampering that human reviewers miss. Their accuracy score is strong (8/10) thanks to layering AI analysis on top of 6+ government databases. Speed is decent for identity checks (real-time) but drops for employment verification. Cost is the main drag — enterprise-only pricing.


**Best for:** Companies in BFSI, fintech, and e-commerce that need AI-powered document fraud detection and liveness verification for remote onboarding.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** IDfy’s AI catches forged documents and identity swaps. But the most common fraud in India is fake employment history, not forged documents — and for that, SalaryBox Verify’s EPFO check is faster, cheaper, and equally accurate.


## #4 SpringVerify — Best Package Value With Published Pricing (14/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 4/10 2–5 business days for most checks. Identity: 24–48 hours. Some checks up to 10 days.


**Cost** 6/10 Rs. 799–Rs. 1,599 per candidate. Published pricing. Free trial available.


**Accuracy** 4/10 Manual employer/university outreach. No real-time government database API for employment.


**Why It Ranks #4:** SpringVerify is one of the few Indian BGV platforms with published pricing and a free trial, earning it a 6/10 on cost. Their HRMS integration (Darwinbox, greytHR, Keka) makes it convenient for growing companies. But speed suffers (2–10 days) because verification relies on manual outreach to employers and universities, and accuracy is limited (4/10) because manual outreach can be gamed by candidates providing fake references.


**Best for:** Growing companies (50–500 hires/year) that use an HRMS and want an all-in-one package with predictable pricing.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** SpringVerify bundles more check types (criminal, education, reference), but at Rs. 799+ per candidate it’s 4–30x more expensive than SalaryBox Verify’s per-check pricing. And the employment check is less accurate — manual outreach vs. government EPFO records.


## #5 OnGrid — Best API Speed With Government Databases (18/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 8/10 Real-time APIs for PAN, Aadhaar, EPFO, DigiLocker. Court/police checks: 2–7 days.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom per-API-call pricing. Not published. Requires sales engagement.


**Accuracy** 8/10 EPFO, DigiLocker, eFIR, Aadhaar, PAN — direct government database APIs.


**Why It Ranks #5:** OnGrid offers 200+ check types and is one of the few platforms with direct DigiLocker integration for education verification through government-signed certificates. Their[FY 2024-25 Annual Report](https://www.ongrid.in/annual-report-fy-2024-25) shows 3.6 lakh individuals flagged with verification failures. Speed (8/10) and accuracy (8/10) are strong for API-based checks, but cost drags the total down — unpublished pricing, custom quotes, and the need for developer integration.


**Best for:** Tech companies with in-house developers who want to build government database checks into their own ATS or HRMS via APIs.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** OnGrid matches SalaryBox on government database accuracy and adds DigiLocker for education. But it requires a developer to integrate, has no published pricing, and no self-serve dashboard for non-technical HR teams.


## #6 SurePass SureBGV — Best Developer API Platform (18/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 8/10 Real-time APIs for PAN, Aadhaar, DL, UAN/EPFO. Court checks: hours to days.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom API pricing. Not published. Requires sales engagement.


**Accuracy** 8/10 Government database APIs (PAN, Aadhaar, EPFO, DL) + AI document fraud detection.


**Why It Ranks #6:** SurePass serves 3,000+ companies and offers individual API endpoints for each government database, including a dedicated[Employment History by UAN API](https://surepass.io/employment-history-by-uan-api/) . Their speed and accuracy scores match OnGrid (both 8/10), but their check catalogue is narrower (no DigiLocker education verification). Cost remains the bottleneck — unpublished pricing and developer-only access.


**Best for:** Developer teams building custom verification pipelines who want clean, individual government database API endpoints.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** SurePass offers the same government database speed and accuracy via API, but requires developer integration. SalaryBox Verify gives the same core checks through a self-serve dashboard that any HR team member can use in 2 minutes.


## #7 HelloVerify — Best Budget Comprehensive Option (13/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 5/10 Claims 24–72 hours. Court, employment, and education checks take longer.


**Cost** 4/10 Self-service packages starting around Rs. 1,799. Not prominently published.


**Accuracy** 4/10 Manual employer/institutional outreach. AI/ML processing for common checks.


**Why It Ranks #7:** HelloVerify positions itself as a budget-friendly option for startups and mid-sized businesses. According to[HROne’s comparison](https://content.hrone.cloud/?p=56763) , their packages start around Rs. 1,799. Their traffic-light reporting (Suspect/Alert/Good-to-Go) is easy for non-HR founders to read. But speed is moderate (manual checks take days despite the 24–72 hour headline claim) and accuracy depends on manual outreach rather than government database APIs.


**Best for:** Mid-sized companies (50–500 hires/year) that want comprehensive checks at lower-than-enterprise pricing.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** HelloVerify bundles criminal and education checks. But at Rs. 1,799+ per candidate, it’s 9x more expensive than SalaryBox Verify’s basic Rs. 196 check for identity + employment — and slower (days vs. minutes) with lower accuracy (outreach vs. government API).


## #8 BetterPlace verifyBetter — Best for Blue-Collar Workforce (14/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 6/10 Vendor reports average under 24 hours. Criminal/police checks take longer.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom enterprise pricing. Not published. Demo required.


**Accuracy** 6/10 Aadhaar + PAN + EPFO + court databases. AI criminal screening with relevance scoring.


**Why It Ranks #8:** BetterPlace is purpose-built for the blue-collar and gig economy segment. Their WhatsApp-based candidate experience and AI criminal record screening are tailored for high-volume verification of delivery drivers, warehouse workers, and security guards. Accuracy is decent (6/10) thanks to government database access, but speed is variable and cost is opaque.


**Best for:** Gig platforms, logistics companies, and staffing agencies verifying high volumes of frontline workers.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** BetterPlace has WhatsApp workflows and AI criminal screening for gig workers. But for core identity and employment checks, SalaryBox Verify is faster (minutes vs. hours), cheaper (published vs. custom pricing), and equally accurate (same government databases).


## #9 Pietos — Best for Physical Field Verification (13/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 3/10 3–15 business days depending on check type. Physical visits add time.


**Cost** 6/10 Rs. 200–Rs. 2,000 per case. Published pricing tiers.


**Accuracy** 4/10 Digital checks + physical field agents for address and employment. Manual outreach.


**Why It Ranks #9:** Pietos fills a gap that digital-only platforms cannot — physical field verification in Tier 2/3 cities and rural areas. Their hybrid model (digital + field agents) is valuable for industries where in-person address and employment verification is standard practice. Published pricing (Rs. 200–Rs. 2,000) is a plus. But speed is the slowest on this list (3–15 days) because physical visits cannot be automated.


**Best for:** Companies hiring in non-metro areas, or industries like construction, logistics, and manufacturing where physical verification is required.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** Pietos offers physical verification that SalaryBox Verify cannot. But for digital government checks (PAN, EPFO, DL, Voter ID), SalaryBox Verify is 10–50x faster and often cheaper. The ideal approach: SalaryBox Verify for instant digital government checks + Pietos for physical verification where needed.


## #10 Verifacts — Best for Tier 2/3 City Field Checks (9/30)


Metric Score Detail


**Speed** 3/10 3–10 business days. Physical field visits dominate the process.


**Cost** 2/10 Custom enterprise pricing. Not published. Quote-based.


**Accuracy** 4/10 In-person field visits + manual document/reference verification.


**Why It Ranks #10:** Verifacts is one of India’s oldest background verification firms, with a strong on-ground presence in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities. According to[CBI Insights](https://www.cbinsights.com/company/verifacts) , they combine digital processes with physical address visits and in-person reference checks. Their accuracy comes from human expertise rather than technology. But the slowest speed, unpublished pricing, and lack of government database API integration place them at the bottom of this ranking.


**Best for:** Companies that need in-person verification in smaller cities where digital platforms have limited reach, and are willing to wait 3–10 days for results.


**Trade-off vs. SalaryBox Verify:** Verifacts offers the human touch — physical visits, in-person references, local knowledge. But for speed, cost, and accuracy on digital checks, SalaryBox Verify scores 30/30 vs. Verifacts’ 9/30. Use SalaryBox Verify for instant government checks and Verifacts only when physical presence is non-negotiable.

## Frequently Asked Questions


### 1. Which employee background check tool is the fastest in India?


**SalaryBox Verify** is the fastest background check tool in India for identity and employment checks. PAN, Driving Licence, and Voter ID verifications complete in seconds by querying government databases directly. UAN/EPFO past employment history returns within minutes. No other tool on this list matches this speed without requiring developer integration. Try it at[salarybox.in/verify](https://salarybox.in/verify/) .


### 2. Which background check tool is the cheapest in India?


**SalaryBox Verify** offers the cheapest per-check pricing.


### 3. What makes a background check “accurate” vs. “inaccurate”?


Accuracy depends on the **data source** . Government database checks (PAN via Income Tax, employment via EPFO, DL via MoRTH) are the most accurate because records are maintained by government agencies and cannot be fabricated by candidates. Manual outreach (calling previous employers, mailing universities) is less accurate because candidates can provide fake references or forge documents. Tools like SalaryBox Verify, OnGrid, and SurePass that query government APIs score highest on accuracy.


### 4. Can background check tools detect fake resumes instantly?


Yes, if the tool queries government databases via API. SalaryBox Verify’s UAN/EPFO check reveals a candidate’s complete formal employment history from government records within minutes — showing actual employers, dates, and salary brackets that candidates cannot alter. This instantly exposes fake employers, inflated tenures, and hidden gaps. Tools that rely on manual employer outreach take 2–7 days and can be gamed by candidates providing fake HR contacts.


### 5. Why do some background check tools cost Rs. 26 while others cost Rs. 2,000+?


The cost difference comes from **method of verification** . Tools like SalaryBox Verify query government databases via API — an automated process that costs almost nothing to run — and pass the savings to you. Tools that use manual outreach (calling employers, sending field agents, contacting universities) incur human labour costs, which they pass on as Rs. 500–Rs. 2,000+ per candidate. Enterprise platforms add account management, contracts, and custom reporting to justify premium pricing.


### 6. Do I need all 10 types of background checks for every hire?


No. For 80% of roles, **two checks are sufficient** : PAN verification (confirms identity) and UAN/EPFO employment history (verifies past employers and tenure). These cost Rs. 196 combined on SalaryBox Verify and catch the 4 most common frauds: fake identity, fake employers, inflated tenure, and moonlighting. Add criminal record checks only for finance, security, or childcare roles, and education verification only where a specific degree is legally required.


### 7. How do I compare background check tools objectively?


Use three measurable criteria: **Speed** (how many minutes/hours/days from initiating a check to receiving results), **Cost** (actual per-candidate or per-check price, not a vague “affordable” claim), and **Accuracy** (whether the tool queries government databases directly via API, or relies on manual outreach). Any tool that doesn’t publish its pricing or turnaround time is harder to evaluate objectively.


### 8. Is it legal to run employee background checks in India?


Yes, provided you obtain **written consent from the candidate** before conducting any check. This is required under the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 and the Information Technology Act, 2000. Reputable platforms like SalaryBox Verify include consent collection and data masking as part of their workflow. Running checks without consent can result in legal penalties.


### 9. Can I use multiple background check tools together?


Yes, and this is the recommended approach. Use SalaryBox Verify (30/30 on speed, cost, accuracy) as your foundation for every hire, then layer on specialized tools for specific needs: AuthBridge or SpringVerify for criminal checks, OnGrid for education verification via DigiLocker, Pietos for physical field verification in non-metro areas. This layered approach costs 70–90% less than using a single enterprise platform for every hire.


### 10. What is the minimum background check every Indian employer should run?


At minimum, every employer should run: **PAN verification** (Rs. 26 on SalaryBox Verify) to confirm the candidate’s legal identity, and **UAN/EPFO past employment history** (Rs. 170) to verify their employment timeline from government records. This Rs. 196 combination takes under 5 minutes, queries tamper-proof government databases, and catches fake identity, fake employers, inflated tenures, salary inflation, and moonlighting.
